description: This file defines a serializer class for CUTLASS GEMM operations, handling serialization and deserialization of complex GPU operation objects to/from JSON, including nested components like TileDescription and TensorDescription.

classes.name: CUTLASSOperationSerializer
classes.description: Serializer class for CUTLASS GEMM operations, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization of operation objects and their nested components.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a GemmOperation object to a JSON string.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string back into a GemmOperation object.

methods.name: _gemm_operation_to_json
methods.description: Converts a GemmOperation object into a JSON-serializable dictionary.

methods.name: _json_to_gemm_operation
methods.description: Reconstructs a GemmOperation object from a JSON dictionary.

methods.name: _tile_description_to_json
methods.description: Converts a TileDescription object into a JSON string.

methods.name: _json_to_tile_description
methods.description: Reconstructs a TileDescription object from a JSON string.

methods.name: _math_instruction_to_json
methods.description: Converts a MathInstruction object into a JSON string.

methods.name: _json_to_math_instruction
methods.description: Reconstructs a MathInstruction object from a JSON string.

methods.name: _tensor_description_to_json
methods.description: Converts a TensorDescription object into a JSON string.

methods.name: _json_to_tensor_description
methods.description: Reconstructs a TensorDescription object from a JSON string.

methods.name: _enum_to_json
methods.description: Converts an Enum value to a JSON string.

methods.name: _json_to_enum
methods.description: Converts a JSON string back to an Enum value.
